defect: Duplicate string keys overwrite the earlier entry (stringMembers[key] = ...) instead of keeping the first, so the later member silently replaces the first in the member table.
why: With duplicate keys the formatter table then binds the wire key to the second member while the diagnostic points at the first, so an input value can be read into a different member than the one the author sees.
writtenBy: engine lane (Miska), drafted by an isolated Claude Sonnet builder that never saw prompts, pipeline or review output
